text: Ethics in AI is an important topic today. AI systems can be biased if they learn from unfair data, which may lead to wrong decisions about people. Fairness means treating everyone equally, no matter who they are. Privacy is also a big concern, because AI often collects and uses personal information. Companies must protect this data and use it safely. Transparency means people should understand how AI makes decisions. Finally, responsible AI development means building technology that helps society and does not cause harm. Governments, companies, and users all need to work together to make sure AI is used in an ethical way.
